s: adjective
affectedly modest or shy especially in a playful or provocative way
خجالو و متکلف، به خصوص به شیوه‌ای بازیچه‌گونه یا اغواکننده
She gave him a coy smile while pretending not to notice his obvious interest.
adjective
showing marked and often playful or irritating evasiveness or reluctance to make a definite or committing statement
اجتناب‌کننده و ابهام‌آمیز، مایل به عدم اظهار نظر واضح یا قطعی
adverb
in a coy manner
به طور خجالتی یا شرمگین‌انه
she pouted and looked at him coyly
noun
the affectation of being demure in a provocative way
شیوه‌ای شرمگینانه و اغواکننده
Her coyness about the compliment was clearly just an act to seem more attractive.
noun
small wolf native to western North America
گرگ کوچک بومی آمریکای شمالی غربی
A coyote howled in the distance as we hiked through the desert.
noun
someone who smuggles illegal immigrants into the United States (usually across the Mexican border)
قاچاقچی مهاجران غیرقانونی به ایالات متحده
